study: Amazon Itupiranga, Pará; exploratory map review; no event confirmation

summary.ru: Среди четырёх пространственно разнесённых HV-кандидатов оптика не подтверждает однозначно новую вырубку; два пригодных для местного сравнения октябрьских снимка уточняют контекст, но не показывают однозначную SAR-причину.
summary.en: Across four spatially separated HV candidates, optical imagery does not unambiguously confirm new forest loss; two October scenes improve local context but do not establish the SAR cause.

selection.rule: six valid native NISAR dates; median of Sep 4/16/28 minus median Jul 18/Aug 11/23 <= -3 dB and at least 2/3 post dates <= pre median -3 dB; 8-connected components were not required for the pixel screen; candidates thinned >=1 km; controls forest-class cells with smallest absolute shift, similarly thinned
selection.candidate_count_rule: HV-only per-cell screen; 1,452 flagged. Not comparable to the earlier joint HH/HV dense component count of 83 under a different rule (which also applied component grouping).
selection.candidate_vs_joint_note: This selection is HV-only. The stored joint3dbflag is an independent per-cell calculation requiring both HH and HV to meet <= -3 dB median shift and >=2/3 post persistence; it is not the selector for displayed candidates.

coordinate_mapping: Dense native cell center: EPSG:32722 x=x_first+c*x_step, y=y_first+r*y_step -> WGS84 via pyproj. Optical crop center mapped using stored EPSG:4326 bounds of exact Sentinel-2 preview PNG (256x256). No sparse-to-dense point join performed.

maps.joint3dbflag_rule: both HH and HV median Sep 4/16/28 minus median Jul 18/Aug 11/23 <= -3 dB and each band individually <= own pre median -3 dB on at least 2 of 3 post dates; six observations valid in both bands

observation.ru: В июле и августе видны открытая светлая поверхность и линейные расчистки у лесо-полевой мозаики. 3 октября белая облачная область подходит к точке и закрывает часть окна; 21 октября точка лежит на уже открытом/мозаичном рисунке. Между чистыми участками дат не видно уверенно нового компактного просвета.
observation.en: July and August show open pale ground and linear clearings at a forest/field mosaic edge. On October 3, a bright cloud approaches and partly obscures the target window; on October 21, the target lies in an already open/mosaic pattern. No confidently new compact opening is visible between clear portions of the dates.

interpretation.ru: Текущие карты не подтверждают новую расчистку; октябрьская сцена показывает существующий сельхозкрай, но окно 3 октября частично закрыто облаком. Влажностный/радарный эффект и мелкое изменение остаются возможными.
interpretation.en: The maps do not confirm new clearing; the October scene shows an existing agricultural edge, while the October 3 window is partly cloud-obscured. Moisture/radar effects and small changes remain possible.

maps.limitations: 3 Oct local SCL clear fraction 0.809 (cloud-adjacent pixels may remain); 21 Oct 1.0. Global scene cloud percentage is not local quality.

interpretation.en: New forest loss is not confirmed: the visible pattern largely follows a pre-existing boundary; a small change cannot be ruled out.

observation.ru: В июльских и октябрьских окнах видна открытая мозаика с изогнутой древесной полосой; небольшое тёмное пятно северо-западнее креста повторяется на 3 и 21 октября. Нового отчётливого пятна в точке не видно.
observation.en: July and October windows show open mosaic with a curved wooded strip; a small dark spot northwest of the cross recurs on October 3 and 21. No distinct new patch is visible at the target.

interpretation.ru: Повторяющийся тёмный объект и существующая мозаика не дают визуального свидетельства новой потери леса; природа SAR-сдвига остаётся неизвестной.
interpretation.en: The recurring dark feature and existing mosaic provide no visual evidence of new forest loss; the cause of the SAR shift remains unknown.

observation.en: On October 21, the cross lies in apparently continuous canopy at an irregular edge; no obvious new opening is visible. Visible portions on October 3 are also wooded, but part of that window is cloud/no-data.

interpretation.ru: Поздняя чистая оптика не подтверждает новую потерю леса в этой точке; это не исключает малый/кратковременный или иным образом неразрешимый радарный эффект.
interpretation.en: The later clear optical image does not confirm new forest loss at this point; a small/transient or otherwise unresolved radar effect is not excluded.

selected_scenes.indices: NDVI=(B08-B04)/(B08+B04); NDMI=(B08-B11)/(B08+B11), after scale/offset; no RGB-derived indices

overlays.pixel_registration: north-up affine raster; bounds are outer pixel edges; source grid pixels interpreted at pixel centers by affine transform

source_grid.pixel_support: 20 m square; B04/B08 bilinear resampled from native 10 m; B11/SCL native 20 m; all metrics on common 20 m grid

overlays.reprojection: Rasterio/GDAL warp EPSG:32722 -> EPSG:4326 north-up; RGB bilinear; SCL nearest-neighbor. Source native grid transform is from pixel outer bounds, so samples are located at native pixel centers.

legend.display: fixed RGB stretch; qualitative true-color appearance only; not an index

overlays.valid_mask_policy: PNG alpha=255 only where nearest-reprojected SCL is class 4 vegetation, 5 not-vegetated, or 6 water AND all calibrated RGB bands are finite; otherwise alpha=0. Cloud/shadow/unclassified/snow/no-data and other SCL classes are transparent.
overlays.resolution_qualification: Source optical composites are on a common 20 m grid; B04/B03/B02 were bilinear-resampled from native 10 m before this geographic warp. Output is a display overlay, not native 10 m imagery or an area/condition measurement.
